head: Skybits weather app shows your forecast in pixel-art cities
dek: Skybits is a free iPhone weather app that draws live weather over pixel-art city scenes, with rain falling and lights coming on after sunset. Its Sky Studio lets you mix a city's weather and time of day and send it as a postcard image or animated GIF.
details: It has hourly forecasts for temperature, rain and wind, a seven-day outlook, UV and moon phase, Home Screen widgets and up to 12 saved places. Forecasts, postcards and 30 city scenes are free; a one-time Skybits Plus purchase unlocks all 245 cities, with no subscription. The weather data comes from Apple Weather. The developer is listed as Hafiz Abdur Rehman.
where: iPhone, App Store, free with a one-time upgrade
means: If you'd like a weather app that looks like a little window onto a city, this one adds a playful look to the usual forecast.
todo: Try the free version first: check whether your city is one of the 30 free scenes before you pay for Plus.
